decisions.reason: The approved Hero V terminal serves as the fixed geometric source; the decision strengthens the accent's matching rule without changing the Hero V geometry.
The shared terminal remains the defining gesture across the glyph family; the new exact-overlay constraint specifically changes how the É accent is derived, not the terminal treatment itself.
Exact one-to-one matching between the Hero V terminal and É accent does not change the second V geometry. Its separate right-arm refinement is already represented by its own message-128 MODIFY.
The exact accent derivation rule does not alter the supporting E and L letterform construction or reactivate this deferred Requirement.
The source decision does not change the second V's smaller, subordinate visual prominence relative to the Hero V.
The geometric derivation of the É accent does not change the deferred kerning requirement or its unified-reading goal.
The exact vector relationship between the Hero V terminal and É accent does not alter the deferred champagne material treatment.
The optional request for a construction diagram is specific evidence for the accent derivation and does not modify the standing requirement to explain the design intention of each review round.
